facts.text: You play the T side on Mirage.
The bomb has not been planted; about 35 s remain on the round clock.
Your team is carrying the bomb in Middle.
Your team has no utility left.
Your team is positioned: 1 in CT Spawn, 1 in Middle, 1 in Stairs.
Two defenders were last seen in CT Spawn 6 to 13 s ago.

Keep the default and take information first
Fake one site, then rotate to the other

qualifiers.label: Send two players wide with a trade
Send one player alone behind the defence
Play slowly and listen for rotations
Use utility together to take space
Keep some utility back for the post-plant

debrief.whyItWorks: With limited clock, taking space with utility while the defence is unsettled is the most reliable way to plant in time. Here, 3 players faced 2 with about 35 seconds left.
debrief.cost: It spends the team's utility and options at once, leaving little for the post-plant.
debrief.assumption: The defenders cannot rotate enough players to the site before the plant.
debrief.breaksWhen: The defence stacks the chosen site and has its own utility ready for the execute.

evidenceReview.explanation: The utility left sets how much of the plan can be forced rather than hoped for. Here the team held 0 utility items.
The round clock bounds how long any plan can take. Here the round clock stood near 35 seconds.
The head count sets how many duels the team can lose and still carry out its plan. Here it was 3 against 2.

debrief.followupReview: The proposed best answer to the new information was: Continue the chosen plan. Reasoning: an opponent has been eliminated, which favours pressing the advantage instead of changing course.
debrief.strongestAlternative: The closest alternative was to send a single lurker behind the defence, playing a player down for a thinner site defence.

counterfactual.changedFact: The defenders are known to have stacked the target site.
counterfactual.effect: The execute meets a full defence, and taking information or faking becomes stronger.
